# Model Selection and Performance Analysis

## 1\. Library Import and Data Preparation

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)

df <- read.csv("modeling_results_all.csv") %>% clean_names()

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE = as.numeric(rmse),
    R2 = as.numeric(rsquared),
    Dataset = as.character(dataset),    
    ModelFamily = factor(model_family),
    CV = factor(cv_type),
    MAE =  as.numeric(mae),
  )

df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(RMSE), !is.na(R2)) %>% 
  mutate(
    RMSE_logged = ifelse(Dataset %in% c("V1", "V3", "V4", "V7"), log(RMSE), RMSE)
  )
```

## 2\. Visualization of Results


### 2.1 Scatter Plot: Logged RMSE vs. R²


```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = paste0("V", 1:11)))

ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = RMSE_logged, y = R2, color = ModelFamily, shape = CV)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset, scales = "free_x") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Logged RMSE vs R² Across Datasets, Models, and CV Techniques",
    x = "RMSE (Logged) - Lower is Better",
    y = "R² - Higher is Better",
    color = "Model Family",
    shape = "CV"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "gray60"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",  
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted"), 
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),  
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1)    
  )
```

### 2.2 Heatmaps: RMSE and R²

```{r}
df_viz <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    model_cv = paste(model_name, CV, sep = "_"),
    Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = paste0("V", 1:11))
  )

# Heatmap for RMSE
ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Dataset, y = model_cv, fill = RMSE_logged)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", mid = "yellow", high = "darkgreen",
    midpoint = median(df_viz$RMSE_logged, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "RMSE\n(Logged)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Heatmap: RMSE",
    x = "Dataset Version",
    y = "Model & CV Combination"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Heatmap for R²
ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Dataset, y = model_cv, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", mid = "yellow", high = "darkgreen",
    midpoint = median(df_viz$R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "R²"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Heatmap: R² ",
    x = "Dataset Version",
    y = "Model & CV Combination"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Heatmap for R²
ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Dataset, y = model_cv, fill = MAE)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", mid = "yellow", high = "darkgreen",
    midpoint = median(df_viz$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "R²"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Heatmap: MAE ",
    x = "Dataset Version",
    y = "Model & CV Combination"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

### 2.3 Line Plots by Model Type


```{r}
df_clean %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = paste0("V", 1:11))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dataset, y = R2, color = CV, group = interaction(model_name, CV))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_family + model_name, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "R² Performance Across Datasets by Model and CV Type",
    x = "Dataset Version",
    y = "R²",
    color = "CV Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

df_viz %>%
```
